entries.dialogueText: He pointed at one of the statues in the corner as we walked. It was a white marble sculpted representation of Albrecht Renan, the founder of the Renan Aristocracy.

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: ""Was he the one? The original owner..."
entries.dialogueText: "Was he the one? The original owner of the Maroon Palace?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes. It was built as his summer re..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. It was built as his summer residence."
entries.menuText: "Yes. It was built as his summer residence."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""As far as I know he didn't use it..."
entries.dialogueText: "As far as I know he didn't use it much. It was Soll who transformed this place."
entries.menuText: "As far as I know, he didn't use it much. It was Soll who transformed this place."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""His name is Albrecht Renan, Chairm..."
entries.dialogueText: "His name is Albrecht Renan, Chairman Malenyev. And yes, he was."
entries.menuText: "His name is Albrecht Renan, Chairman Malenyev. And yes, he was."

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: ""I thought when Tarquin Soll came t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thought when Tarquin Soll came to power, he worked towards removing the republic's connection to its feudal past."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I don't know. It's just a statue t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't know. It's just a statue to me."
entries.menuText: "I don't know. It's just a statue to me."

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: ""It is interesting that he removed..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is interesting that he removed the images of the last kings but not the older figures. Was he fond of the aristocracy, or the man?"

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: ""To me, all of this has meaning. It..."
entries.dialogueText: "To me, all of this has meaning. It is always useful to know why certain historical images are displayed while others kept hidden."

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: ""You are not a man of history, then?""
entries.dialogueText: "You are not a man of history, then?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""As a matter of fact, I am. My fiel..."
entries.dialogueText: "As a matter of fact, I am. My field was history before I entered politics."
entries.menuText: "As a matter of fact, I am. My field was history before I entered politics."

entries.title: Player: ""To be honest, not really.""
entries.dialogueText: "To be honest, not really."
entries.menuText: "To be honest, not really."

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: "The future interests me more than the past."
entries.menuText: "The future interests me more than the past."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""As a matter of fact, I am quite in..."
entries.dialogueText: "As a matter of fact, I am quite interested in history. Maybe just not the statues."
entries.menuText: "As a matter of fact, I am quite interested in history. Maybe just not the statues."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I have no idea. You have to ask th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have no idea. You have to ask the man himself."
entries.menuText: "I have no idea. You have to ask the man himself."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I believe he was fond of both. He..."
entries.dialogueText: "I believe he was fond of both. He cared a lot about our national values."
entries.menuText: "I believe he was fond of both. He cared a lot about our national values."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I know he despised the kingdom. Bu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know he despised the kingdom. But I think he still needed a glorious past to make people proud. That's where Renan came in."
entries.menuText: "I know he despised the kingdom. But I think he still needed a glorious past to make people proud. That's where Renan came in."

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: ""How come you are uninterested in y..."
entries.dialogueText: "How come you are uninterested in your own past, then? I'm not the one who put these statues here."

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: ""You cannot see what the future hol..."
entries.dialogueText: "You cannot see what the future holds for you if you're not literate in history."

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: ""It is important to learn from the..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is important to learn from the past. Or else we'll keep on making the same mistakes."

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: ""That's what I suspected. If it was..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's what I suspected. If it was not going to be the kingdom he despised so much, it made sense to look further back."

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: ""Well, I think he couldn't erase hi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, I think he couldn't erase history just like that. He still needed a past that made him and his people proud. If it was not going to be the kingdom he despised so much, it made sense to look further back."

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: ""In the end, I'm just an old man.""
entries.dialogueText: "In the end, I'm just an old man."

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: ""He just left in the parts he liked..."
entries.dialogueText: "He just left in the parts he liked. Isn't it fascinating how a single person can alter history just like that?"

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: ""It is perhaps even more divided th..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is perhaps even more divided than ever. There are still wars in every corner of the world. There is still poverty, violence and slavery."

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: ""Don't you think we need to step up..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't you think we need to step up as leaders of this world to try to put an end to this?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I completely agree. We need proper..."
entries.dialogueText: "I completely agree. We need proper international cooperation to tackle these problems."
entries.menuText: "I completely agree. We need proper international cooperation to tackle these problems."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I do. That's why I'm meeting with..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do. That's why I'm meeting with you. To change something."
entries.menuText: "I do. That's why I'm meeting with you. To change something."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I think United Contana isn't entir..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think United Contana isn't entirely innocent in these conflicts."
entries.menuText: "I think United Contana isn't entirely innocent in these conflicts."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We can only do so much.""
entries.dialogueText: "We can only do so much."
entries.menuText: "We can only do so much."

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: ""Precisely.""
entries.dialogueText: "Precisely."

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: ""I never claimed we were innocent.""
entries.dialogueText: "I never claimed we were innocent."

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: ""I don't play games like the Arcasi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't play games like the Arcasians. I can tell it as it is."

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: ""Perhaps we cannot ever create our..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps we cannot ever create our utopias. But that doesn't mean we shouldn't try."

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: ""Good.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good."

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: ""And that's where the CSP comes in.""
entries.dialogueText: "And that's where the CSP comes in."

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: ""Yes. We were involved with a lot o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. We were involved with a lot of conflicts that turned bloody. Was there any other way? I don't know. Probably not."

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: ""Today, the whole continent is at p..."
entries.dialogueText: "Today, the whole continent is at peace, Mr. Rayne. And now the rest of the world is furious."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Those days must have been devastat..."
entries.dialogueText: "Those days must have been devastating."
entries.menuText: "Those days must have been devastating."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""In the end, you formed the largest..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the end, you formed the largest country in the world."
entries.menuText: "In the end, you formed the largest country in the world."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""There are many countries who look..."
entries.dialogueText: "There are many countries who look up to United Contana. You are not alone."
entries.menuText: "There are many countries who look up to United Contana. You are not alone."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""They are afraid of your power. Con..."
entries.dialogueText: "They are afraid of your power. Contana was never united before."
entries.menuText: "They are afraid of your power. Contana was never united before."

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: ""They are afraid of the power of th..."
entries.dialogueText: "They are afraid of the power of the people, Mr. Rayne. They are afraid that the oppressed will one day unite. That was the power of our revolution in Contana."

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: ""That's exactly what our enemies ar..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's exactly what our enemies are furious about."

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: ""They were. But the revolution live..."
entries.dialogueText: "They were. But the revolution lives on in Contana now. It's time we help others."

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: ""We have. And now our responsibilit..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have. And now our responsibility is great. We cannot sit back and let Arcasian imperialism enslave the third world."

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: ""I still remember how Contana was a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I still remember how Contana was a massive war zone. When all the warring states were supplied weapons by the west. Kings and dictators killed each other."

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: ""Oh, yes. Renan.""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, yes. Renan."

entries.dialogueText: He was wearing his usual "political uniform," grayish-green trousers and a simple tunic with a soft turn-down collar.

entries.menuText: "Would you want to have a rest, Chairman Malenyev? We can talk later if you're not feeling well."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I led him up a set of back stairs t..."
entries.dialogueText: I led him up a set of back stairs to another unoccupied office with a balcony overlooking the Hill of Pride. We took our seats around a table. It was rather chilly outside.

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: ""Oh, no, I'm fine. I didn't come he..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, no, I'm fine. I didn't come here to sleep. I just need some fresh air, Mr. Rayne."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Reaching into his distinctive jacke..."
entries.dialogueText: Reaching into his distinctive jacket, he pulled out a pipe and placed some tobacco leaves inside. The smell of the leaves was overpowering, even outside.

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: ""Chancellor Hegel told me a lot abo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Chancellor Hegel told me a lot about you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After preparing his pipe, he lit it..."
entries.dialogueText: After preparing his pipe, he lit it with a match. His eyes drifted away from me while the wind blew his hair and smoke to the side. He stared at the horizon to the north.

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: ""Valgsland needs all the support we..."
entries.dialogueText: "Valgsland needs all the support we can give to bring back peace to the island. We can't let our allies stand alone."

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev

entries.dialogueText: "All of this *firepower* is now being directed at the locals in Heljiland. They want to finally eliminate the Valgish culture in the island, and set up a military base close to Valgsland."

entries.dialogueText: "Whether they are Valgs, Agnolians or Contanans who are being killed, it doesn't matter."

entries.speaker: Leon Malenyev
entries.title: Leon Malenyev: ""In the end, people are dying. And..."

entries.title: Leon Malenyev: ""Our pact aims to develop the parts..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our pact aims to develop the parts of the world that have been left out. Bring people together and make a stand. Show the world the power of the people when they unite."
